_comment: Revert / bridge / desk code → bank line (docs/NPCS.md §5). `line` is the main-path apology; `why` is the Ask-why half (protocol words allowed). {release_in} is filled from the record the error names. Keys are the SDK ERROR_SIGNATURES names (@bloxchain/sdk contract-errors), Teller Desk codes, Privy codes and bridge codes.

default.line: Sorry — the counter could not do that.
default.why: The Teller Desk returned an error the branch has no line for yet. The code and message are below.

TargetNotWhitelisted.line: That payee isn't on our approved list.
TargetNotWhitelisted.why: Your account's guard only lets `transfer` be called on targets whitelisted for that selector. The demo token was whitelisted at Account Opening; anything else is refused by the contract.

ResourceNotFound.line: That payee isn't on our approved list — the branch has no record of it.
ResourceNotFound.why: The guard registry has no entry for that target/selector pair. The whitelist is per function selector, not per account.

ItemNotFound.line: The branch has no record of that item.
ItemNotFound.why: A registry lookup (role, function, whitelist entry) found nothing under that key.

ItemAlreadyExists.line: That is already on file — nothing to add.
ItemAlreadyExists.why: The registry refuses a duplicate entry (a role, a selector, a whitelist target). Provisioning treats this as already done.

ResourceAlreadyExists.line: That is already on file — nothing to add.
ResourceAlreadyExists.why: The guard registry already holds this entry.

NoPermission.line: You're not allowed to do that from this counter.
NoPermission.why: The caller does not hold the action required on this selector. Permissions are checked on two selectors — the execution function and the handler — and this caller is missing one of them.

NoPermissionForFunction.line: You're not allowed to do that from this counter.
NoPermissionForFunction.why: The caller has no permission at all for this function selector.

RestrictedOwner.line: Only the account holder can ask for that.
RestrictedOwner.why: This function is restricted to `OWNER_ROLE`. Staff cannot call it for you.

RestrictedOwnerRecovery.line: Only the account holder or Security can ask for that.
RestrictedOwnerRecovery.why: Restricted to the owner or the recovery role.

RestrictedRecovery.line: That is Security's job, not ours.
RestrictedRecovery.why: Restricted to `RECOVERY_ROLE` — the Security Officer at the side door.

RestrictedBroadcaster.line: Only the teller's desk may submit that.
RestrictedBroadcaster.why: Restricted to `BROADCASTER_ROLE`, which the Teller Desk holds.

CannotModifyProtected.line: That part of your file is sealed — it can't be changed here.
CannotModifyProtected.why: Protected roles (owner, broadcaster, recovery) are managed by SecureOwnable, not by the runtime role registry.

BeforeReleaseTime.why: `approveTimeLockExecution` compares the record's `releaseTime` to the block timestamp of the approval and reverts `BeforeReleaseTime` until it has passed. The clock on the wall is that record; nobody here can shorten it.

TransactionNotPending.line: That wire is no longer waiting in the vault.
TransactionNotPending.why: The record has already been released, recalled or failed — only PENDING records can be approved or cancelled.

CanOnlyApprovePending.line: That wire is no longer waiting in the vault.
CanOnlyApprovePending.why: Approval is only valid for a PENDING record.

CanOnlyCancelPending.line: That wire is no longer waiting in the vault.
CanOnlyCancelPending.why: Cancellation is only valid for a PENDING record.

TransactionNotFound.line: We have no wire by that number.
TransactionNotFound.why: No record with that txId exists on your account.

TransactionStatusMismatch.line: That wire isn't in a state where we can do that.
TransactionStatusMismatch.why: The record's status does not allow this transition.

TransactionIdMismatch.line: The slip and the record don't match — let's write a new one.
TransactionIdMismatch.why: The txId in the signed slip differs from the record it was applied to.

PendingSecureRequest.line: There's already a request of that kind waiting — let it settle first.
PendingSecureRequest.why: SecureOwnable allows one pending request per operation type.

NOT_PENDING.line: That wire is no longer waiting in the vault.
NOT_PENDING.why: The Teller Desk read the record before sending and it was not PENDING any more (released, recalled, or failed).

RECORD_*.line: The vault took the request, but the record didn't end up where we expected — let me check the board.
RECORD_*.why: The transaction was mined but the record's final status was not the one this action should produce. The board is re-read from the chain.

InvalidSignature.line: That slip isn't signed by the account holder.
InvalidSignature.why: The EIP-712 signature does not recover to `metaTx.params.signer`, or the signer is not the owner.

InvalidSignatureLength.line: That slip isn't signed properly — let's write a new one.
InvalidSignatureLength.why: The signature bytes are not 65 bytes long.

SignerNotAuthorized.line: That slip isn't signed by the account holder.
SignerNotAuthorized.why: The recovered signer does not hold the action the slip claims.

ECDSAInvalidSignature.line: That slip isn't signed properly — let's write a new one.
ECDSAInvalidSignature.why: The signature is malformed (OpenZeppelin ECDSA rejected it).

InvalidSValue.line: That slip isn't signed properly — let's write a new one.
InvalidSValue.why: Malleable or out-of-range `s` component in the signature.

InvalidVValue.line: That slip isn't signed properly — let's write a new one.
InvalidVValue.why: Invalid recovery id `v` in the signature.

MetaTxHandlerSelectorMismatch.line: That slip was written for a different counter.
MetaTxHandlerSelectorMismatch.why: The handler selector in the signed slip does not match the function the broadcaster called (`msg.sig`).

MetaTxHandlerContractMismatch.line: That slip was written for a different branch.
MetaTxHandlerContractMismatch.why: The handler contract in the signed slip is not this account.

InvalidHandlerSelector.line: That slip was written for a different counter.
InvalidHandlerSelector.why: The handler selector is not one this account accepts.

ChainIdMismatch.line: That slip was written for a different wing of the bank.
ChainIdMismatch.why: The chainId in the signed slip is not this chain's. A Remote EVM signature cannot replay elsewhere — by design.

policy_violation.line: The teller's stamp doesn't cover that — the branch can only sign slips for your own account.
policy_violation.why: Privy refused to sign: the request fell outside the per-player policy (verifyingContract / `to` pinned to your account, chainId pinned to this chain). This is the control that stops the session signer touching anyone else's account (K5, V6).

MetaTxExpired.line: That slip expired — let's write a new one.
MetaTxExpired.why: `deadline` is `block.timestamp + duration` at signing time and had passed when the transaction mined. On Remote EVM the block clock is frozen between transactions, so durations are drift-corrected (`metaTxDuration`).

InvalidNonce.line: Someone already used that slip number — writing a fresh one.
InvalidNonce.why: The signer nonce in the slip is not the account's current nonce for that signer. One in-flight slip per player is why the desk serialises them.

GasPriceExceedsMax.line: The network is too expensive for that slip right now.
GasPriceExceedsMax.why: `maxGasPrice` in the slip is below the current gas price.

InsufficientBalance.line: Not enough practice dollars in the account.
InsufficientBalance.why: The ERC-20 transfer would exceed the account's balance. Ask Ines for a top-up.

InvalidPayment.line: The payment details don't add up.

OperationFailed.line: The account tried, but the operation failed.

InvalidOperationType.line: This counter doesn't offer that service.
InvalidOperationType.why: The operation type hash is not registered in the account's function schemas.

ZeroOperationTypeNotAllowed.line: This counter doesn't offer that service.

NotSupported.line: This branch doesn't offer that yet.
NotSupported.why: The function is not supported by this account.

FunctionSelectorMismatch.line: That slip names a service this counter doesn't provide.
FunctionSelectorMismatch.why: The execution selector does not match the schema it was submitted under.

HandlerForSelectorMismatch.line: That slip names a service this counter doesn't provide.
HandlerForSelectorMismatch.why: The handler registered for this selector is not the one that was called.

ConflictingMetaTxPermissions.line: Those two permissions can't both be granted — the branch keeps them apart on purpose.
ConflictingMetaTxPermissions.why: The role registry refuses conflicting meta-transaction actions on one selector. It is also why no role holds the untimed meta-approve on transfers here.

InternalFunctionNotAccessible.line: That's an internal desk — customers can't call it.

ContractFunctionMustBeProtected.line: That function must stay behind the counter.
ContractFunctionMustBeProtected.why: Registry rule: contract functions must be protected.

DefinitionNotIDefinition.line: The branch's rule book is misconfigured — please tell the manager.
DefinitionNotIDefinition.why: A definitions library address is not an IDefinition contract.

OnlyCallableByContract.line: Only the account itself can do that.

InvalidAddress.line: That address isn't one the counter can take.

NotNewAddress.line: That's the same address as before.
NotNewAddress.why: The new value equals the current value.

TimeLockPeriodZero.line: A cooling period of zero isn't allowed here.

NewTimelockSame.why: New timelock equals the current one.

RoleWalletLimitReached.why: Max wallets for the role reached.

MaxWalletsZero.line: A role needs room for at least one wallet.

MaxRolesExceeded.line: The branch has all the roles it can hold.

MaxHooksExceeded.line: Too many hooks on that function.

MaxFunctionsExceeded.line: That role covers as many services as it can.

ArrayLengthMismatch.line: The paperwork doesn't line up — let's redo it.

IndexOutOfBounds.line: The paperwork doesn't line up — let's redo it.

BatchSizeExceeded.line: Too much in one batch — the desk will split it.

RangeSizeExceeded.line: Too much in one batch — the desk will split it.

InvalidRange.line: The paperwork doesn't line up — let's redo it.

InvalidOperation.line: That's not an operation this counter can do.

CustomError.line: The account said no, and it said why in its own words.
CustomError.why: A custom error the SDK could not name. Raw data is in the message.

ReadableText.why: A string revert. On Remote EVM an empty revert after idle time usually means an expired meta-transaction — see REMOTE-EVM.md §1a.

Unknown.line: The vault would not accept that.
Unknown.why: The revert data could not be decoded.

NO_ACCOUNT.line: You don't have an account here yet — Ines at Account Opening will sort you out.
NO_ACCOUNT.why: The Teller Desk has no AccountBlox on file for your wallet. Open one first.

NOT_CONFIGURED.line: Your account is on file, but the desks aren't authorised for it yet — ask Ines to re-check your account.
NOT_CONFIGURED.why: The Teller Desk knows your account address but never recorded the end of provisioning (`configured` / `roleSet`), so the role grants the counter and the vault need may be missing. Ines's "Re-check my account" runs the provisioner again: it reads the chain first and only sends what is missing.

NO_WALLET.line: Your sign-in has no wallet attached yet — try the desk again.
NO_WALLET.why: The Privy user has no embedded EVM wallet; the overlay creates one at Account Opening.

NO_MANAGER.line: The manager isn't in today — release it yourself at the vault window.
NO_MANAGER.why: The Teller Desk has no `MANAGER_PK`, so the BRANCH_MANAGER runtime role has no holder on this branch (T3 lore mode).

AUTH.line: I'll need you signed in for that — Ines can help at Account Opening.
AUTH.why: The Teller Desk rejected the request: no Privy access token, or the wallet address does not belong to the authenticated user.

LOGIN_CANCELLED.line: No rush — come back when you're ready to sign in.
LOGIN_CANCELLED.why: The Privy sign-in was dismissed before completing.

POLICY.line: That's above what I can do at this counter — it goes through the vault.
POLICY.why: Branch policy: amounts over the instant limit are routed to the time-locked lane. This limit is enforced by the Teller Desk, not by the contract (REFLECTION §2.2 partial invariant).

BAD_ARGS.line: I can't read that slip — check the payee and the amount.
BAD_ARGS.why: The bridge or the Teller Desk rejected the arguments (not an address, not a decimal amount, not a record id).

TIMEOUT.line: The desk is taking longer than usual — the board will catch up when it answers.
TIMEOUT.why: No response from the bridge within the call's timeout. The Teller Desk may still complete the job; stage events and the focus reconcile will update the board.

RPC.line: The branch can't reach the ledger right now.
RPC.why: Network or HTTP failure between the shell and the Teller Desk / RPC.

CHAIN.line: The ledger isn't answering — try again in a moment.
CHAIN.why: Chain-level failure reported by the bridge.

UNKNOWN_METHOD.why: The game asked the bridge for a method it does not expose. Add a bridge method that calls an existing Teller Desk route (HANDOFF §5c).

NOT_IMPLEMENTED.line: That desk opens in a later unit.
NOT_IMPLEMENTED.why: Route exists but is planned for a later construction unit (ENS U5, FX S1).

INTERNAL.line: Something went wrong behind the counter.
INTERNAL.why: Unclassified failure in the bridge or the Teller Desk. The message is below.
